features.name: Cascade Falls
features.description: A compact waterfall on Cascade Falls Trail is one of the park's most searched family hiking destinations, reached from the Avalon and Orange Grove trail network rather than the Hollofield headquarters.

details.positionQuality: Exact CC BY 4.0 camera coordinates cross-checked against the official Avalon/Orange Grove trail map
details.imageAlt: Cascade Falls at Patapsco Valley State Park

features.name: Orange Grove Swinging Bridge
features.description: A pedestrian suspension bridge crosses the Patapsco River in the Orange Grove area and connects the Grist Mill and Cascade Falls trail network.

details.positionQuality: Exact CC BY-SA 4.0 camera coordinates cross-checked against the official Orange Grove destination and trail map
details.imageAlt: Orange Grove Swinging Bridge at Patapsco Valley State Park

features.name: McKeldin Rapids
features.description: A dramatic rapid at the meeting area of the Patapsco's branches is a scenic McKeldin trail destination, but the rapids and pool below are explicitly closed to swimming because of dangerous currents.

details.positionQuality: Exact CC BY 2.0 camera coordinates cross-checked against the official McKeldin map and Maryland DNR rapids warning
details.imageAlt: McKeldin Rapids at Patapsco Valley State Park

features.name: Thomas Viaduct Viewpoint
features.description: The 1835 Thomas Viaduct carries an active railroad across the Patapsco near the Avalon area; established ground-level views reveal its curved stone arches without entering railroad property.

details.positionQuality: Exact CC BY 2.0 camera coordinates cross-checked against Maryland DNR's official historic-site description west of the Avalon contact station
details.imageAlt: Thomas Viaduct Viewpoint at Patapsco Valley State Park
